SWZ.note: A health-sector pilot, not general administration.

facts.fact: Jacaranda Health reports a pilot, August 2022 to March 2023, of its AI-enabled two-way SMS tool PROMPTS for infant immunization tracking with the Ministry of Health's Expanded Programme on Immunization, enrolling over 1,300 mothers, with the ministry interested in national scale-up.

SWZ.note: Tool adapted from a Kenyan platform; no local model or computing stated.
